mentions.name: Flopper
mentions.description: This tool makes it easier to find reliable information about HPC GPUs and systems by comparing HPC GPUs, power, and other specs in a single page; a calculator to determine how many FLOPS or GW a data center can deliver is in progress.
mentions.problem: Reliable information about HPC GPUs and systems is really hard to find.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Turns out HPC GPUs and systems are realllllly hard to find reliabile information about. I've built another project which aims to make this easier. Compare HPC GPUs, Power et al in a single page. Working on a calculator to determine how many FLOPS or GW your DC can do. Executives loveeee this!

https://flopper.io
